name: arovas
description: Arovas publishes what you build in ChatGPT as a working app with its own link: forms, trackers and small tools that save their data. Describe the tool, ask ChatGPT to publish it with Arovas, and get a link anyone can open.

interface.longDescription:
Arovas publishes what you build with ChatGPT as a real, working app with its own link. Describe the tool you need, ask ChatGPT to publish it with Arovas, and get a link anyone can open: no servers, databases or technical setup.

Built for people who aren't developers: marketing, HR, operations, sales, educators and founders who want a sign-up form, an internal tracker, a quote calculator or a small tool for their team.

What ChatGPT can do with Arovas:
- Create a new app and reserve its address
- Publish a new version, keeping the information it already holds
- Show whether an app is online and which version is live
- List your apps, to keep working on one from another conversation
- Put an earlier version back online
- Read the latest entries your app has saved (only if you allow it)

Every app keeps its own data, with rules for who can see and add entries. Publishing and going back to an earlier version always ask for your confirmation. Arovas never deletes your apps or their data from a chat.
capabilities: Create a new app with its own link
Publish a new version of an app
Show whether an app is online and which version is live
Put an earlier version back online
Read the entries an app has saved
defaultPrompt: Make a sign-up form for my workshop and publish it with Arovas.
Show me the apps I have in Arovas.
Show me the latest entries in my sign-up form.

positive.expected_behavior: Lists Workshop Sign-up, Team Tasks and Customer Feedback with their addresses on arovas.page.

positive.prompt: Is my Workshop Sign-up app online in Arovas? Which version is live?
positive.expected_behavior: Says the app is online at https://workshop-signup.arovas.page and that version 2 is live.

positive.description: Read the entries an app has saved
positive.prompt: Show me the latest sign-ups in my Workshop Sign-up app in Arovas.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the most recent sign-ups from the signups table, with names, companies and sessions.

positive.description: Build and publish a new app
positive.prompt: Make a simple event RSVP form with name, email and number of guests, and publish it with Arovas.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the app rules, creates a new app, asks to confirm the publish, and returns a working link on arovas.page where the form saves responses.

positive.description: Go back to an earlier version
positive.prompt: Put the previous version of my Workshop Sign-up app back online in Arovas.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks to confirm, then puts version 1 back online and returns the app's link. The sign-ups are kept.

negative.description: Request to delete an app, which Arovas does not do from a chat
negative.prompt: Delete my Team Tasks app from Arovas.

negative.description: Request about an app that does not exist in the account
negative.prompt: Show me the entries of my Payroll app in Arovas.

negative.description: General question unrelated to publishing apps
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Lima today?

publication.release_notes: First release: create, publish and update apps with their own link, check their status, go back to earlier versions and read the entries they save.
